entries.en: Oh-ho-ho... Fuck! That's what I'm talking about... Thanks...
entries.ro: Oho-ho... Pula mea! Da' asta-i! Mulțumesc...

entries.en: Let's get you out of here.
entries.ro: Hai să te scot de aici.

entries.en: Don't look too good. Can you even walk?
entries.ro: Nu arăți prea bine. Mai poți merge?

entries.en: Need to find a way outta here. Fast.
Needs someone who can actually use it.
entries.ro: Îi trebuie cineva care chiar știe să-l folosească.

entries.en: Listen, I know a way out, but you're dealin' with those corpo-fucks.
entries.ro: Ascultă, știu o ieșire, dar ai de-a face cu corpo-fuștii ăia.

entries.en: You're preaching to the choir – that's why I'm here.
entries.en_m: Ha, you're preaching to the choir – that's why I'm here.
entries.ro_m: Ha, predici corului – de-aia sunt aici.

entries.en: Could run a hundred yard dash on bloody stumps, hurdles included.
entries.ro: Aș putea alerga o sută de yarzi pe niște cioturi nenorocite, cu garduri cu tot.

entries.en: So we doin' this? You ready?
Thanks. Could pack an extra punch.
entries.ro: Mulțumesc. Ar avea mai multă bătaie.

entries.en: Thanks, but I'm packin' my own.
No time to waste. Let's go.
Hold up... OK, we just got word from Reggie. Got a ride outta here, parked outside. Waitin' for us.
entries.ro: Stai... OK, tocmai am primit vești de la Reggie. Avem o mașină de scăpat de-aici, parcată afară. Ne așteaptă.

entries.en: Message just hit my inbox too. Best get movin'.
entries.ro: Tocmai mi-a intrat un mesaj. Mai bine plecăm.
